title: Servo Output
text: Write to standard servo output channels, 1 input, 1 output, {Block input signal} sets Units of the block input signal; {Install new board} sets the register a board < no board, {Delete current board} sets the delete the current board, {Board setup} sets the up the board, {Sample time}, {Maximum missed ticks} sets the number of timer ticks by which your model can trail, {Show “Missed Ticks” port} sets the send number of missed ticks to port Missed, {Yield CPU when waiting} sets the yield CPU while kernel waits for hardware, {Output channels} sets the channel vector that selects other output, {Minimum pulse duration} sets the duration of the control, {Maximum pulse duration} sets the duration of the control, {Initial value} sets the value that the channel generates before execution starts and {Final value} sets the value that the channel generates after execution ends. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Servo Data
ports.summary: Servo data to write to output channels double | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | boolean

params.name: Install new board
params.values: Register a board < no board selected > (default)

params.name: Maximum missed ticks
params.values: Number of timer ticks by which your model can trail the kernel 10 (default) | integer

params.name: Show “Missed Ticks” port
params.values: Send number of missed ticks to port Missed Ticks ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Yield CPU when waiting
params.values: Yield CPU while kernel waits for hardware ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Output channels
params.values: Channel vector that selects other output channels 1 (default) | vector

params.name: Block input signal
params.values: Units of the block input signal Degrees (default) | Radians | Normalized bipolar | Normalized unipolar

params.values: Specify the value that the channel generates before execution starts vector
